suggest.title: Suggest a listing
suggest.description: Send us the link to a neuroscience position on the employer’s own page, or to an event, funding call or resource. An editor checks every suggestion; nothing is published automatically.
suggest.intro: Know of a neuroscience position that is not on Gliagora yet? Send us the link to the original posting, and an editor will check it.
suggest.employers: We list positions at universities, research institutes and companies, from the employer’s own page. We do not list positions placed by recruitment agencies.
suggest.otherKinds: You can also suggest events, funding, papers, news and resources. We keep them and add them when those sections of Gliagora open.
suggest.unavailable: The form is temporarily unavailable. Please email the link to <email>hello@gliagora.com</email> instead.
suggest.noscript: The spam check on this form needs JavaScript. If JavaScript is turned off, you can email the link to <email>hello@gliagora.com</email> instead.

url.label: Address of the original page
url.hint: The employer’s or organiser’s own page, starting with https:// or http://.

kind.resource: A resource, such as a dataset or a tool

note.label: Note (optional)
note.hint: Anything that helps us check it, such as the deadline. Plain text, up to 500 characters. Please do not include anyone’s personal details.

email.label: Your email address (optional)
email.hint: Only if you want us to tell you the outcome.

consent.label: Email me the outcome of this suggestion
consent.hint: We use your email address only for this and delete it 90 days after our decision. You must be 16 or older. See the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> and the <kvkk>KVKK information notice</kvkk> (in Turkish).

suggest.spamNote: To keep out spam programs, your browser solves a small puzzle before the form is sent, and we keep a scrambled form of your IP address for 24 hours to limit how often the form can be sent. <link>How we protect the form</link>

errors.title: There is a problem
errors.urlMissing: Enter the address of the page.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter the full address of a web page, such as https://www.example.org/jobs/123.
errors.urlScheme: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.
errors.urlCredentials: Enter the address without a user name or password in it.
errors.urlTooLong: Enter an address of 2,000 characters or fewer.
errors.noteTooLong: Shorten the note to 500 characters or fewer.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address in the correct format, such as name@example.org.
errors.emailTooLong: Enter an email address of 254 characters or fewer.
errors.emailMissing: Enter your email address, or untick the box if you do not want us to email you the outcome.
errors.consentMissing: Tick the box if you want us to email you the outcome, or leave the email field empty.
errors.needsJs: The spam check did not run: the page had not finished loading, or JavaScript is turned off or blocked in your browser. Wait until the page has loaded and send the form again, or email the link to hello@gliagora.com.
errors.spamCheck: The spam check has expired or did not work. Please send the form again.
errors.rateLimited: You have sent several suggestions in the last hour. Please try again later.
errors.unavailable: The form is temporarily unavailable. Please email the link to hello@gliagora.com instead.
errors.failed: Something went wrong and your suggestion was not saved. Please try again later, or email the link to hello@gliagora.com and mention reference {reference}.

sent.title: Thank you for your suggestion
sent.check: An editor opens the original page and checks that it fits Gliagora.
sent.publish: If it fits, we publish our own short summary with a link to the original page. Nothing is published automatically.
sent.outcome: If you gave us your email address, we tell you the outcome and delete the address 90 days after our decision.
sent.changedMind: Changed your mind about the email? Write to <email>privacy@gliagora.com</email>, and we delete your address.

report.title: Report a problem
report.description: Tell us about a wrong fact, a closed position or a broken link on Gliagora, or ask us to correct or remove content about you.
report.intro: Tell us if something on Gliagora is wrong or should not be there. An editor checks every report against the original posting.
report.introInstitution: Tell us if something about this institution on Gliagora is wrong. An editor checks every report against the institution’s own website and, where there is one, its record in the Research Organization Registry (ROR).
report.takedown: How we handle corrections and removal requests, and how quickly we act, is explained on the <link>notice and takedown page</link>.
report.unavailable: The form is temporarily unavailable. Please email your report to <email>hello@gliagora.com</email> instead.
report.noscript: The spam check on this form needs JavaScript. If JavaScript is turned off, you can email your report to <email>hello@gliagora.com</email> instead.

wrong-fact.label: A fact is wrong
wrong-fact.hint: For example, the deadline, the institution or the type of position differs from the original posting.
wrong-fact.hintInstitution: For example, the institution’s name, city, country or website is wrong.

closed.label: The position has closed
closed.hint: The employer has filled or withdrawn it, or no longer accepts applications.

broken-link.label: A link does not work
broken-link.hint: The link to the original posting, or another link, leads to an error or to the wrong page.
broken-link.hintInstitution: The link to the institution’s website, or another link, leads to an error or to the wrong page.

not-employer.label: It does not come from the employer
not-employer.hint: A recruitment agency placed it, or the link does not lead to the employer’s own page.

personal-rights.label: It is about you and harms your rights
personal-rights.hint: For example, your name or other information about you is wrong, or should not be there. Turkish law (Law No. 5651, Article 9) lets you ask us to correct or remove it. We need your email address to answer you.

details.label: Details
details.hint: What is wrong, and what should it say instead? If your report is about another page on Gliagora, include its address. Plain text, up to 2,000 characters. Please do not send sensitive data, such as information about your health.

email.label: Your email address
email.hint: Needed for a request about your personal rights, so that we can answer you. Optional for other reports: give it if you would like a reply. We use it only to answer you about this report, and keep it with the report for 2 years after we close it. See the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> and the <kvkk>KVKK information notice</kvkk> (in Turkish).

report.spamNote: To keep out spam programs, your browser solves a small puzzle before the form is sent, and we keep a scrambled form of your IP address for 24 hours to limit how often the form can be sent. <link>How we protect the form</link>

errors.title: There is a problem
errors.kindJobOnly: Choose what is wrong from the options listed: that choice is for positions only.
errors.detailsTooLong: Shorten the details to 2,000 characters or fewer.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address in the correct format, such as name@example.org.
errors.emailTooLong: Enter an email address of 254 characters or fewer.
errors.emailRequired: Enter your email address: we need it to answer a request about your personal rights.
errors.needsJs: The spam check did not run: the page had not finished loading, or JavaScript is turned off or blocked in your browser. Wait until the page has loaded and send the form again, or email your report to hello@gliagora.com.
errors.spamCheck: The spam check has expired or did not work. Please send the form again.
errors.rateLimited: You have sent several reports in the last hour. Please try again later, or email your report to hello@gliagora.com.
errors.unavailable: The form is temporarily unavailable. Please email your report to hello@gliagora.com instead.
errors.failed: Something went wrong and your report was not saved. Please try again later, or email it to hello@gliagora.com and mention reference {reference}.

sent.title: Thank you for your report
sent.personalRightsTitle: A request about your personal rights
sent.personalRights: We confirm within 24 hours that we have received your request, and usually decide within 72 hours. If we decide to remove an item, it goes offline at once.
sent.other: We check the item against the original posting, then correct it, or remove it if it should not be on Gliagora. We reply only if you gave us your email address.
sent.takedown: The <link>notice and takedown page</link> explains how we handle reports and requests.

emails.automatic: This email was sent automatically. To reach us, reply to it or write to {email}.

suggestion.subjectPublished: Your suggestion is now on Gliagora
suggestion.intro: Thank you for suggesting a listing to Gliagora | Neuroscience. You asked us to email you the outcome. You suggested this page:
suggestion.published: We checked the position on the employer's own website and published it on Gliagora:
suggestion.notAdded: We have decided not to add it to Gliagora.

reasons.not-neuroscience: The position is not in neuroscience or a closely related field, which is what Gliagora lists.
reasons.agency-or-intermediary: It was advertised by a recruitment agency or another intermediary. We list only positions that the employer publishes itself.
reasons.closed: The position had already closed, or its deadline had passed, when we checked it.
reasons.not-a-position: The page does not describe a position that people can apply for.
reasons.not-employer-page: We could not find the position on the employer's own website. We list only positions that the employer publishes itself.
reasons.other: It does not fit what we list on Gliagora.

suggestion.retention: We will delete your email address, together with the link and your note, 90 days after our decision. This is the only email we send you about this suggestion. How we handle your data: {privacyUrl}

report.subject: We have received your report
report.intro: This is an automatic confirmation that we have received your report.
report.introPersonalRights: This is an automatic confirmation that we have received your request about your personal rights.
report.next: We check the item against the original posting, then correct it, or remove it if it should not be on Gliagora. We will reply to this address once we have checked it.
report.nextInstitution: We check the institution’s details against its own website and, where there is one, its record in the Research Organization Registry (ROR), then correct them if needed. We will reply to this address once we have checked it.
report.nextPersonalRights: Our editor will answer you within 24 hours, and we usually decide within 72 hours. If we decide to remove an item, it goes offline at once.
